raw_text: AMTI satellite imagery from March 5, 2024 confirms a flotilla of Chinese Coast Guard and maritime militia vessels surrounding Second Thomas Shoal. Our tracking data shows CCG-5901, the world's largest coast guard vessel, positioned within 2 nautical miles of BRP Sierra Madre. This deployment pattern is consistent with an escalated blockade strategy observed since late 2023. Full analysis and vessel identification available on our interactive map.
